companySlogan: Breaking language barriers with expert OPI, VRI, Translation & Localization services.
companyDescription:
About Kreato Global

Founded in 2020, Kreato Global is a premier Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner dedicated to delivering comprehensive, world-class language solutions. We are passionate about breaking down language barriers and bridging communication gaps for organizations worldwide. By combining top-tier linguistic talent with reliable technology, we ensure seamless, accurate, and culturally appropriate interactions for every client we serve.

Our Core Language Services

We offer a complete ecosystem of language and accessibility solutions tailored to your operational needs:

Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI): On-demand, high-quality audio interpretation for immediate communication needs.

Video Remote Interpretation (VRI): Face-to-face virtual interpretation that provides vital visual context, especially crucial in healthcare.

Remote Simultaneous Interpretation (RSI): Real-time, seamless interpretation designed for multilingual webinars and large-scale virtual events.

Onsite Interpretation: Professional, in-person interpreters deployed directly to your facility for critical meetings.

American Sign Language (ASL): Certified ASL interpreters providing essential accessibility and inclusive communication.

title: Analista de Logística
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
¡Únete a nuestro equipo en Siemens como Analista de Logística y comienza tu carrera en un sector dinámico!

Estamos buscando un Analista de Logística con entusiasmo y ganas de aprender para unirse a nuestro equipo en Siemens El Salvador. Si tienes formación en contabilidad o logística y te apasiona el mundo de la cadena de suministro, esta es tu oportunidad para desarrollarte profesionalmente. Serás una pieza clave en la optimización de nuestros procesos logísticos y aduaneros, asegurando la eficiencia y el cumplimiento en nuestras operaciones.

¿Qué harás en este rol? (Responsabilidades Principales):

  • Gestión Aduanera:
    • Apoyar en el retaceo de las importaciones.
    • Verificar y registrar pólizas de importación (DUCA GT y SV).
    • Asistir en la verificación y depuración de las cuentas de balance (Aduanas y Fletes) al cierre de cada mes.
  • Gestión de Proveedores Logísticos:
    • Verificar tarifas y registrar facturas de proveedores logísticos (GT y SV).
    • Realizar la verificación y cambios de condición de pago para facturas de DHL GT semanalmente.
    • Mantener contacto y seguimiento con proveedores logísticos clave como DHL y KN.
  • Análisis y Reclasificación de Costos:
    • Colaborar en la reclasificación de costos logísticos (GT y SV) al cierre de cada mes.
  • Soporte General:
    • Apoyar en la resolución de incidencias y consultas relacionadas con la logística y aduanas.
    • Participar activamente en la mejora continua de los procesos logísticos.
¿Qué buscamos en ti? (Requisitos):

  • Formación Académica: Título universitario o técnico en Contabilidad, Logística, Administración de Empresas o campo relacionado.
  • Conocimientos:
    • Interés y/o conocimientos básicos en logística y aduanas.
    • Nociones de contabilidad, incluyendo retenciones.
  • Experiencia:
    • Al menos 1 año en actividades similares
  • Habilidades Técnicas:
    • Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel (tablas dinámicas).
    • Se valorará la experiencia con sistemas ERP como SAP.
  • Idiomas: Inglés (50% deseable, para lectura y comprensión básica).
  • Competencias Clave:
    • Atención al detalle y alta capacidad analítica.
    • Proactividad y capacidad para resolver problemas.
    • Organización y gestión del tiempo.
    • Habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
    • Orientación al aprendizaje y mejora continua.
¿Qué te ofrecemos en Siemens?

  • La oportunidad de iniciar y desarrollar tu carrera en una empresa líder a nivel mundial.
  • Un ambiente de trabajo híbrido que combina la flexibilidad con la colaboración en equipo.
  • Aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo profesional en el área de logística y cadena de suministro.
  • Integración en un equipo dinámico y colaborativo.

¿Estás listo para asumir el reto?

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás emocionado por esta oportunidad, ¡nos encantaría conocerte! Envía tu currículum vitae y una breve carta de presentación explicando por qué eres el candidato ideal para este puesto.

Siemens es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y nos comprometemos a crear un entorno inclusivo para todos los empleados. Todas las decisiones de empleo se basan en las necesidades del negocio, los requisitos del puesto y las cualificaciones individuales, sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, nacionalidad, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

title: Accounting Clerk SV
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Job role

We’re looking for a skilled accounting clerk who will work with our financial records and make sure they’re up to date. The records the clerk maintains might include expenditures, receipts, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and profit and loss. The accounting clerk will also be required to work with senior personnel on various projects and assist any and all departments as the need may rise.

Responsibilities

  • Work with [insert your bookkeeping software aka Quickbooks] to manage day-to-day accounts receivable and accounts payable
  • Receive and record cash, checks, and vouchers; reconcile bank account statements.
  • Handle payroll, make purchases, prepare invoices and keep track of overdue accounts.
  • Produce reports, reflecting profit and loss statements, financial statements and balance sheets
  • Keep management informed and up to date through presentations and reports
  • Remain vigilant against fraud and inaccuracy by checking over figures and reports frequently


Requirements

  • +2 years of experience as an accounting/bookkeeping clerk.
  • High school diploma is mandatory; accounting coursework from an accredited institution preferred.
  • Skilled in using MS Office and popular accounting software.
  • Possesses eye for attention to detail
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Integrity; a position that requires one to maintain an entire organization’s financial records requires one’s moral character to be of the highest fibre.
  • Knowledge of basic bookkeeping procedures, best practices and terminology.
  • By applying to this position, we’ll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

title: ANALISTA FINANCIERO
location: Lourdes, La Libertad, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Descripción de la empresa

Somos una compañía comercializadora de bebidas y alimentos con 137 años de experiencia y operaciones en Centroamérica, el Caribe y Sudamérica. Contamos con el portafolio de productos más grande de la región y trabajamos junto a nuestros socios estratégicos Pepsico, Ambev y Beliv ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras a nuestros clientes.

En CBC sabemos construir vínculos sólidos y duraderos. Sabemos escuchar a los consumidores para entender sus necesidades y ofrecerles las mejores marcas en las distintas ocasiones de consumo.

Llevamos sabor y frescura al mundo con la ambición de convertirnos en una compañía multicategoría que siga expandiendo sus horizontes. Lo hacemos con el entusiasmo de ver sonreír a nuestro equipo, a los nuestros y a quienes disfrutan lo que hacemos.

Nuestra cultura y energía transformadora tienen a la pasión como el motor que nos impulsa a ser mejores y a conquistar nuevos desafíos. Trabajamos con el disfrute de hacer juntos lo imposible.

Descripción del empleo

Análisis de la información financiera y contable, depuración de cuentas de balance y correcciones de cuentas de gastos. Con el objetivo de velar por las obligaciones mercantiles de la compañía, para proporcionar la información oportunamente.

  • Revisión detallada de cuentas de balance y de resultados en SAP, con el fin de verificar si se a realizado eficientemente el proceso financiero.
  • Verificación mensual de las cuentas de arrendamiento NIIF 16.
  • Seguimiento análisis por activaciones.
  • Analizar y detallar las integraciones de cuentas de balance, con el objetivo de verificar que haya un registro de cada una de estas.
  • Elaboración de estados financieros y libros legales, para llevar un control de todos los procesos.

Requisitos

  • Graduado en Ingeniería, administración de empresas o afines
  • Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en puestos similares, manejo de excel avanzado
  • Disponibilidad de horarios.

Información adicional

La misión de Grupo Mariposa es fomentar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad dentro de la industria global de alimentos y bebidas. Estamos comprometidos con la excelencia a través de una gestión disciplinada, prácticas innovadoras y una cultura dinámica que acepta el cambio.

title: Spanish AI  Data Trainer - Remote
location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Spanish AI Data Trainer

Location: Remote

Role Overview

This is a remote, hourly-paid contractor role focused on enhancing the safety, accuracy, and reasoning quality of advanced AI systems. You will review AI-generated content, evaluate step-by-step reasoning, and provide expert feedback to ensure outputs are logically sound, clearly explained, and aligned with safety policies.

Working across Spanish and English, you will apply nuanced linguistic, cultural, and policy judgment. Your work will directly support leading AI organizations in improving the safety and alignment of large-scale language models.

This role may involve exposure to sensitive material, including content that is sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, clarity, reasoning quality, and safety compliance
  • Identify logical, methodological, or conceptual errors in model outputs
  • Compare and rate multiple responses based on correctness, safety alignment, and policy adherence
  • Perform fact-checking and validation where required
  • Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to identify vulnerabilities, edge cases, and unsafe behaviors
  • Document decisions with clear, structured reasoning and reproducible evaluation paths
  • Apply and localize safety policies consistently across Spanish and English, identifying slang, cultural nuance, and coded language
  • Escalate ambiguous cases using defined policy frameworks

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Linguistics, Communications, Psychology, Law, Policy, Security Studies, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Native or near-native Spanish proficiency (reading and writing)
  • Minimum C1 English proficiency (reading and writing)
  • 5+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, content moderation, policy operations, compliance, investigations, or related fields
  • Proven LLM red-teaming / adversarial testing experience (required)
  • Strong ability to preserve meaning, intent, and severity across languages
  • Excellent analytical writing and structured reasoning skills
  • High attention to detail and consistency in applying safety policies
  • Ability to work independently in a remote contractor environment
  • Secure handling of sensitive and confidential information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI data annotation, model evaluation, or localization/translation
  • Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar AI platforms
  • Experience working with structured safety taxonomies or policy frameworks
  • Background in investigative, editorial, or analytical roles

title: Aviation Property, Equipment, and Facilities Advisor
location: Ilopango, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Location: Ilopango, San Salvador, El Salvador Remote Work: No Clearance: RSO Work Status: Full-Time Travel Requirements: Local and international travel may be required.

Applications submitted by 02/24/2026 will receive full consideration. Candidates applying after this date may still be reviewed and will remain in our talent pipeline for future opportunities.

Position Description

ATSG is presently identifying candidates for an Aviation Property, Equipment, and Facilities Advisor. The Aviation Property, Equipment, and Facilities Advisor will join the ATSG team to enhance our partnership with the U.S. Department of State (DOS) Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs' (INL) Western Hemisphere Program (WHP) – El Salvador task order. The WHP is a large and sophisticated multilateral security effort, provides funding for the USG to assist the governments of the WHP countries with police professionalization, justice sector reform, counter narcotics efforts, border security management, crime and violence prevention, and anti-corruption efforts. Hours for this full-time position will be Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • This is a key position
  • Mentors and advises Salvadoran Air Force leadership and aviation maintenance community personnel on all aspects of maintenance operations and maintainer development, including areas such as supply, acquisitions, and joint management of flying hours with flying units, with a focus on rotary-wing maintenance/operations.
  • Establishes close working relationships with leadership of the Salvadoran Air Force maintenance units and develops a deep understanding of Salvadoran Air Force maintenance requirements, capabilities, and constraints to enable advice that is tailored and sustainable for El Salvador.
  • Provides advice, suggestions, and plans for reducing maintenance-related aircraft downtime while also lowering maintenance-related mishap rates.
  • Provides implementation advice regarding process improvement plans, as approved by the Salvadoran Air Force.
  • Provides advice on projecting needs and planning for procurement of parts and equipment, including how to cycle parts, conduct equipment maintenance, and create budget estimates.
  • Collaborates with Salvadoran military personnel, other contractors, and the U.S. Embassy INL and DoD teams to align and develop plans for maintenance, aircraft, equipment, and facilities.
  • Conducts end use monitoring, where appropriate, on INL-donated aviation equipment.
  • Supports INL and DoD during meetings and visits with key U.S. and Salvadoran government officials, professional associations, other U.S. federal agencies, and U.S. Congressional staff

Minimum Qualifications

  • U.S. citizen, Third Country National, or Local National
  • Embassy Badge is needed
  • Spanish 3/3, English 3/3
  • Must have military history working as a professional helicopter maintainer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in aviation maintenance, aeronautics, engineering, or related field and 15 years of experience in helicopter maintenance.
  • Degree can be substituted for 20 years of relevant experience in aviation maintenance with responsibility over maintenance units and programs.
  • Must be able to read and use technical manuals in English.
  • Must possess advanced technical knowledge of Bell helicopters, including experience with at least two of the following platforms: UH-1H, UH-1N, and/or Bell 412.
  • Must have at least 5 years of experience in roles such as technical inspector, maintenance advisor, or field representative with key responsibilities related to military aviation operations and evaluating military maintenance practices.
  • Must have at least 5 years of experience working with various aviation maintenance roles, including, but not limited to, shop operations, production control, quality control, instruction and training, and aviation warehouse management.
  • Experience briefing technical issues to high-level audiences in Spanish
  • This position is based in Ilopango, San Salvador, El Salvador.

About ATSG

ATSG Corporation is a Veterans Affairs (VA) CVE-Certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) based in Fairfax, VA with branch offices throughout Central America. Since 2004, ATSG has successfully deployed its experience and expertise to support the most challenging and complex projects for various Federal agencies. Our robust portfolio includes cutting-edge technical solutions and professional support in Program Management, Consulting, Operations and Planning Support, Training and Advisory Services, and IT and Knowledge Management. We take pride in our proven dedication to providing expert assistance to our government partners. ATSG provides a variety of services within the Intelligence Community and is experienced in areas such as Mobility, Enterprise Architecture, Data Processing, Law Enforcement Mission Support, and Acquisition Support. Our products may be diverse, but the results are one and the same—on schedule, on budget, and completed with superior quality. As an organization, we are consistently expanding our global footprint in the contracting community. We work hard to honor our commitment to our clients while ensuring our employees feel secure and empowered in their work. We take excellent care of our team, so they may have the freedom and confidence to focus on their missions and provide nothing but the best output on the work site and at home.

ATSG Corporation is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer, our applicants and employees are protected from discrimination. Visit https://www.eeoc.gov/ for more information. Equal access to programs, services and employment is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the Human Resources Department. To comply with Federal law, ATSG Corporation participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.

This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 60-741.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals on the basis of protected veteran status or disability and require affirmative action by covered prime contractors and subcontractors to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. To comply with Federal law, ATSG Corporation participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.

We respectfully request not to be contacted by recruiters and/or staffing agencies.

Application Requirements

  • All applications must be submitted in .pdf, .doc, or .docx format.
  • Applications and resumes for this position are only accepted via electronic submission through ATSG Corporation’s Consolidated Applicant Tracking System (CATS).
  • Mailed, emailed, faxed, or hand-delivered applications and resumes will not be accepted.
  • The decision to interview an applicant is based solely on the information received for this position from their electronic application and/or resume.

title: Circuit Delivery Coordinator
location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

About Your New Role

As a Circuit Delivery Coordinator within our Service Delivery team, you will be responsible for managing third-party resources, ensuring timely delivery of customer orders with specified quality standards. This role involves communicating regularly with project managers, reviewing sales orders, prioritizing workload, driving escalations when necessary, and maintaining effective communication with customers, vendors, and internal teams.

This is a Full-Time, 100% Remote opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support assigned project managers and the PM team in the provisioning of new orders to business customers for internet, voice, and SDWAN services.
  • Process carrier orders, including but not limited to, new services, upgrades, moves, changes, and disconnects.
  • Ordering Voice Services including Phones & Porting Numbers
  • Request & Manage Dispatches
  • Manage third-party resources, both internal and contracted, to ensure timely delivery of customer orders meeting specified quality standards.
  • Communicate regularly with project managers, providing updates throughout the delivery cycle.
  • Prioritize and manage daily workload effectively.
  • Drive escalations as necessary to achieve results and act as a liaison for customer or carrier orders.
  • Ensure timely and effective communication with customers, vendors, sales teams, and peer organizations.
  • Status large project installations, communicating order status accurately.
  • Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

What You'll Need For Success

  • 1+ Years of experience within the telecommunications industry.
  • Internet Circuit ordering with Carriers preferred
  • VOIP experience strongly recommended.
  • Ability to document dependencies and priorities clearly.
  • Experience managing escalations independently.
  • Adaptability to dynamic environments.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service and soft skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Project management and organizational skills.
  • High integrity and ethical conduct.
  • Team player with a passion for success.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and PC applications.

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

title: Level 3:IT Support Specialist & Client Support
location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
LEVEL3:MSP RELATIONSHIP AND PROJECT LEAD

Teamswell is a high-growth nearshore outsourcing company working for US companies. Our mission is to help small and medium-sized US businesses grow and become more profitable by having access to highly engaged, skilled, and experienced talent at a fair price, and to generate career opportunities for bilingual professionals in Latin America with fair compensation and professional and personal growth opportunities.

We are currently looking for a LEVEL 3 - MSP Relationship and Project Lead. This is a Systems Administrator and Client Relationship Lead position at a 30-year-old IT Managed Services Provider. The person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms. They are the senior technical authority that clients rely on - and they need to be someone a non-technical founder trusts as much as a technical CTO respects.

If your candidate can diagnose a security incident and then explain what happened to an operations manager in plain language - and leave that person feeling confident, not confused - they belong here.

In Teamswell every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our client's success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. Our LEVEL 3 - MSP Relationship and Project Lead will possess the skills and experience required and will also possess a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. We value people who are good communicators, quick learners, scrappy about finding creative solutions to problems, and conscious of their work quality. We expect all our team members to deliver excellence in both technical expertise as well as in their everyday relationships with their team.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of our security tool stack (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cynomi, KnowBe4, etc.) across client environments
  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for escalated issues across Mac workstations, networks, Google Workspace, and SaaS platforms
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents independently with clear, client-readable documentation
  • Lead technical projects: migrations, security tool rollouts, network upgrades, compliance implementations
  • Develop process automation to reduce repetitive manual work (not infrastructure-as-code; think workflow efficiency)
  • Own recurring technical issues and implement long-term root-cause fixes
  • Support monitoring, patching (including CVE remediation alerting), and incident response workflows
  • Evaluate new platforms to determine their suitability as part of our tool stack
  • Perform system updates, backups, and security audits
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client accounts. You own the relationship, not just the ticket queue
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, confident language for non-technical stakeholders (startup founders, ops managers, office managers)
  • Lead client-facing project presentations: scoping, status updates, and post-implementation reviews
  • Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 team members to share knowledge and elevate the team's client communication standards
  • Bridge the gap between subject matter experts and end-users - ensure that SOPs, documentation, and client-facing instructions are user-friendly and accessible
  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and proactively communicate them to clients and internal leadership
  • Contribute to and improve knowledge base documentation with a client-readability lens

Requirements

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, and security project implementation
  • Strong Mac/macOS support experience. Candidates without extensive Apple experience must obtain Apple Desktop Support certification within 90 days
  • Experience administering Google Workspace environments for distributed/remote teams
  • Strong cybersecurity literacy: hands-on experience with zero-trust SaaS security platforms (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cisco Umbrella, KnowBe4, or equivalent)
  • Solid networking fundamentals (VPNs, firewalls, routing), ideally supporting Cisco Meraki environments
  • Experience with endpoint management / MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, or similar)
  • Demonstrated experience leading SaaS security implementation projects end-to-end: from scoping and proposal through deployment and client sign-off
  • Demonstrated experience as the primary point of contact for client accounts - not just an escalation resource, but the person the client calls first
  • Proven ability to explain technical issues to non-technical audiences in plain language and leave them feeling confident, not overwhelmed
  • Experience leading or co-leading client meetings, project kickoffs, and status reviews
  • High customer satisfaction scores or equivalent evidence of strong client relationships (references, testimonials, NPS)
  • Comfort with ambiguity: startup clients often don't know what they need, and you help them figure it out
  • Soft Skills
  • Ownership mindset - if it's your account, it's your problem until it's solved
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision across multiple time zones
  • Continuous improvement orientation: you don't just fix the ticket, you fix the system that created the ticket
  • Strong written communication - client-facing emails and documentation should be clear, professional, and warm

title: Analista de Estrategia y Proyectos
location: La Libertad, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Propósito del puesto:

Brindar soporte a la gerencia de estrategia en dos frentes: seguimiento y monitoreo operativo de la estrategia (KPIs, plan anual, reportería ejecutiva) y custodia operativa del portafolio de proyectos clave, asegurando la ejecución disciplinada de la estrategia y entrega efectiva en tiempo, calidad y costo.


Responsabilidades:

-Apoyar a la gerencia de estrategia en la construcción, consolidación y actualización del plan estratégico anual, integrando insumos de las distintas direcciones.

-Brindar seguimiento periódico a los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) de la compañía y direcciones, identificando desviaciones y elaborando reportes ejecutivos para CEO, Directores y Junta Directiva.

-Recopilar, analizar y visualizar información cuantitativa y cualitativa para soporte de la toma de decisiones de la gerencia de Estrategia y la Dirección Ejecutiva (análisis ad-hoc, benchmarks, tendencias del mercado e industria azucarera).

-Coordinar la agenda estratégica y los comités de seguimiento: convocar, preparar materiales, levantar minutas y dar tracking a acuerdos hasta su cierre con CEO, Directores y Gerentes.

-Custodiar operativamente el portafolio de proyectos estratégicos, mantener cronogramas, hitos, entregables y semáforos de avance actualizados, asegurando una visión consolidada del estado del portafolio.

-Velar por el cumplimiento de la metodología y los estándares de gestión de proyectos (plantillas, ritmos de reunión, repositorio único de información, gobernanza), apoyando a los líderes de proyecto en su aplicación.

-Acompañar la post-implementación de proyectos clave verificando la captura de beneficios comprometidos (ahorros, eficiencias, KPIs impactados) y reportando resultados vs. caso de negocio.


Perfil:

-Carrera universitaria en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Finanzas, Economía o afín.

-Deseable formación o cursos en gestión de proyectos y/o estrategia.

-Pensamiento estratégico, comunicación ejecutiva y orientación a resultados.

-Experiencia de 2 años en roles de análisis estratégico, planeación, gestión de proyectos o a fines.

title: OPERADOR DE FACILIDADES
location: Lourdes, La Libertad, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Descripción de la empresa

Somos una compañía comercializadora de bebidas y alimentos con 137 años de experiencia y operaciones en Centroamérica, el Caribe y Sudamérica. Contamos con el portafolio de productos más grande de la región y trabajamos junto a nuestros socios estratégicos Pepsico, Ambev y Beliv ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras a nuestros clientes.

En CBC sabemos construir vínculos sólidos y duraderos. Sabemos escuchar a los consumidores para entender sus necesidades y ofrecerles las mejores marcas en las distintas ocasiones de consumo.

Llevamos sabor y frescura al mundo con la ambición de convertirnos en una compañía multicategoría que siga expandiendo sus horizontes. Lo hacemos con el entusiasmo de ver sonreír a nuestro equipo, a los nuestros y a quienes disfrutan lo que hacemos.

Nuestra cultura y energía transformadora tienen a la pasión como el motor que nos impulsa a ser mejores y a conquistar nuevos desafíos. Trabajamos con el disfrute de hacer juntos lo imposible.

Descripción del empleo

Asegurar de forma eficiente los suministros de aire, vapor y energía eléctrica con la finalidad de que se direccione correctamente hacia las líneas de producción de la planta.

  • Mantenimiento rutinario a los equipos de las diferentes áreas de operación con fi de dar el mantenimiento correspondiente a torres de enfriamiento y las distancias maquinarias de la planta.
  • Reportar toda condición y acción que pueda generar un riesgo para la seguridad ocupacional al igual junto con toda condición que genere un impacto negativo en el ambiente al igual que cumplir las normas y políticas establecidas de seguridad y medio ambiente
  • Revisión de compresores de aire y Revisión de Plantas de Emergencias con la finalidad de tener el equipo en óptimas condiciones.
  • Inspecciones visuales y rutinarias de subestaciones eléctricas con el fin de evitar algún percance o emergencia en las diferentes áreas de la planta.

Requisitos

  • Técnico Industrial o afines
  • Mínimo 1 años de experiencia en puestos similares.
  • Disponibilidad de horarios.

Información adicional

La misión de Grupo Mariposa es fomentar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad dentro de la industria global de alimentos y bebidas. Estamos comprometidos con la excelencia a través de una gestión disciplinada, prácticas innovadoras y una cultura dinámica que acepta el cambio.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper – E-commerce Business
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (QuickBooks – Multi-Company)

Location: Remote

Hours: Part-time, ~15–20 hours per month

Start: ASAP

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Part-Time Bookkeeper to manage accounting for three companies using QuickBooks. This role is responsible for keeping all books accurate, up to date, and executive-ready. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working directly with leadership.

This position will also involve bringing all three companies fully up to date by uploading and reconciling historical receipts, invoices and transactions from August 2025 through January 2026.

Key Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Reconciliation

  • Upload and categorize receipts and transactions for all three companies
  • Upload and reconcile historical receipts, invoices and transactions (Aug 2025–Jan 2026)
  • Complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Reconcile Bill.com transactions, including vendor bills, invoices, and payments
  • Reconcile sales across multiple channels, including Shopify, marketplaces, and payment processors
  • Ensure sales, fees, refunds, and payouts are accurately recorded and matched to bank deposits
  • Maintain accurate and current general ledger
  • Perform journal entries (J/E) as needed (accruals, adjustments, corrections)

Financial Reporting & Oversight

  • Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports for the President, including:

○ Profit & Loss

○ Balance Sheet

○ Cash Flow overview

○ General Ledger

  • Update and maintain budget spreadsheets and financial tracking files used for different reports
  • Ensure financial reports align with budgets and flag variances
  • Maintain and monitor the balance sheet for accuracy
  • Provide clear visibility into cash flow trends
  • Proactively notify leadership when costs increase, expenses spike, or anomalies appear

Executive Support & Communication

  • Participate in a weekly executive meeting to:

○ Review reconciliations

○ Review Bill.com activity and outstanding items

○ Review sales reconciliation across channels

○ Review budget vs. actuals and financial trends

○ Discuss financial status and cash flow

○ Address questions on current or past transactions

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies across QuickBooks, sales platforms, Bill.com, bank records, and budget reports
  • Ensure leadership has confidence in the accuracy and clarity of financials

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Bookkeeper managing multiple companies
  • Strong expertise in QuickBooks (Online or Desktop)
  • Hands-on experience reconciling:

○ Bill.com invoices, bills, and payments

○ Multi-channel sales (Shopify, marketplaces, payment processors)

  • Journal entry (J/E) capability is a must
  • Experience with bank, credit card, vendor, and revenue reconciliation
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and the general ledger
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Comfortable working directly with executives
  • Reliable, organized, and proactive communicator

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting e-commerce or subscription-based businesses
  • Ability to identify cost trends, margin changes, and flag financial risks
  • Experience cleaning up or catching up historical books
  • Familiarity with tools such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Stripe, PayPal, Bill.com, Ramp, or similar

Time Commitment & Compensation

  • 15–20 hours per month
  • Flexible schedule with required attendance at weekly executive check-ins
  • Compensation commensurate with experience

If this sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now! ✨

title: Python Game Developer (Panda3D) - Remote
location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Python Game Developer (Panda3D)

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Job Summary

Join our customer's team as an expert Pyhton Game Developer (Panda3D), where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge AI training projects using one of the most robust and flexible open-source game engines. This specialized role focuses on harnessing Panda3D’s capabilities to deliver immersive, high-performance simulations compatible with both legacy and contemporary hardware.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize 3D game simulations and environments using Panda3D for AI training applications.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to transform requirements into technical solutions.
  • Implement, maintain, and debug Python and C++ codebases integrated with Panda3D.
  • Contribute to version control workflows using GitHub to ensure smooth project collaboration.
  • Ensure cross-platform compatibility and performance across diverse hardware configurations.
  • Document architectural decisions, code, and processes clearly to support collaborative development.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, brainstorming sessions, and team meetings, emphasizing exceptional verbal and written communication.

Required Skills And Qualifications

  • Proven, hands-on experience developing with Panda3D—experience with similar engines does not substitute.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and C++ programming languages.
  • Strong command of GitHub for code management, branching, and pull requests.
  • Deep understanding of 3D graphics pipelines, simulation logic, and cross-platform development.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills—clear documentation and collaboration are critical.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, meeting deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior game development experience for AI, simulation, or training purposes.
  • Familiarity with optimizing 3D assets for performance across a range of hardware.
  • Background in collaborative, distributed Agile environments.

title: Associate Portfolio Manager
location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
The Associate Portfolio Manager is a core execution role on the Portfolio Management team. You will own the systematic, bottom-up monitoring of FundThrough's entire client portfolio, escalate deteriorating accounts to the Portfolio Manager and Risk team, and maintain the operational controls that keep the portfolio healthy.

You will be the first line of observation across client health signals: invoice aging, payor behavior, MCA balances, tax liabilities, dilution trends, and bank connectivity. You will also own the monthly insurance aging report and contribute to ongoing process improvement initiatives across the PM function.

This role sits at the intersection of data, judgment, and cross-functional coordination. You are expected to work independently on the bulk of weekly monitoring tasks while partnering closely with the Portfolio Manager, Account Management, and Collections.

About the company:

FundThrough is a leading fintech company accelerating cash flow and enabling growth for small and medium-sized businesses that sell to large customers and wait to get paid. Based in Toronto and operating across North America, FundThrough's AI-powered invoice funding platform gives B2B businesses fast, customized funding offers to get their invoices paid in a few days, rather than a few months, and get quick access to cash they've already earned.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in financial services, lending, or credit/risk analysis
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in large data sets and financial statements
  • High attention to detail, especially at the invoice and payment level
  • Clear and structured written communication skills for risk updates and presentations
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building processes in a developing function
  • Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and meet tight deadlines

Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio Monitoring: Conduct weekly systematic reviews of client accounts using a risk model, track changes, and prepare detailed write-ups on invoice aging, payor trends, MCA balances, and compliance status
  • Risk Flag Communication: Post structured client risk updates, coordinate with cross-functional teams, set funding blockers, and conduct payment audits to resolve anomalies
  • Credit Insurance Reporting: Prepare monthly AWAC aging reports, annotate claimable balances, document non-claimable items, and participate in credit insurance broker calls
  • Compliance Enforcement: Monitor compliance requirements, open and manage Salesforce cases, escalate non-responses, and enforce funding holds for tax liabilities or compliance gaps
  • Portfolio Risk Reviews: Summarize weekly client reviews into monthly portfolio reports, align narratives with the Portfolio Manager, and finalize presentations with the data team
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Account Management, Collections, and other teams on client risk issues, respond promptly to follow-ups, and contribute to process improvements

Benefits

  • Opportunity to leave your mark on a growing startup
  • An incredibly diverse team of brilliant minds from all over the world
  • Competitive compensation
  • Family-friendly policies
  • Work from home
  • Birthday treats, and a lunch of your choice every week (one of our values is Fun & Food!)

Open and honest is one of our core values at FundThrough and in this spirit, we are sharing we do not use AI tools in our hiring process and kindly request that applicants refrain from using AI during the interview process.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a criminal record check is a condition of employment. FundThrough encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

companyDescription:
O Grupo Loop nasceu para atender à grande demanda por soluções industriais nas áreas de construção civil, mecânica, elétrica e automação.

Com mais de 25 anos de experiência no mercado, somos especialistas em gestão de grandes obras e projetos Turn-Key. Nosso compromisso é oferecer inovação e transformação através de soluções personalizadas e tecnologia de ponta para um setor altamente dinâmico e exigente.

Nossa missão é oferecer as melhores soluções em Engenharia, Automação, Painéis Elétricos e Saneamento à indústria brasileira, desde o planejamento e projeto inicial até a entrega das instalações e start-up das máquinas (Turn-Key).

Entendemos as principais dificuldades das indústrias em encontrar uma empresa que ofereça serviços integrados, a falta de conhecimento técnico de empresas concorrentes em projetos complexos, bem como atrasos no cronograma.

Por essa razão, priorizamos o relacionamento próximo com nossos clientes, atuando com total transparência, sempre atentos à qualidade de nossos serviços, ao cronograma e orçamento da obra. Além disso, prestamos suporte total ao cliente, do projeto à entrega da obra e/ou start-up das máquinas, e assistência técnica pós-venda.

Dessa forma, o Grupo Loop oferece vantagens competitivas significativas, como uma equipe multiprofissional altamente qualificada para lidar com projetos complexos, uso de tecnologia de ponta em todos os projetos, e soluções sos medida visando superar desafios e surpreender a indústria em cada trabalho.

Além disso, atuamos em projetos Turn-Key abrangendo toda a infraestrutura (civil, mecânica, elétrica e automação) e de EPC (Engenharia, Suprimentos e Construção).

Conecte-se ao Grupo Loop e prepare-se para transformar seus desafios em soluções inovadoras e eficientes.

title: Sales Team Lead/Manager
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Sales Team Lead / Sales Manager

Contract Type: Independent Contractor (Full-time capacity)

Working hours: US EST/PST

100% Remote - manage a global sales team!

👋 About Us

At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe-inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI-integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.

Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team-members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.

All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!

We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!

💻 The Role

We are seeking a high-energy, execution-focused Sales Team Lead / Sales Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our sales department. In this role, you aren’t just a strategist – you are the "engine room" manager. You will lead both our Inbound and Outbound teams, ensuring that every lead is pursued, every process is followed, and every representative is performing at their peak.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales, your primary mission is to control execution. You will take the overarching sales goals and turn them into daily wins through rigorous coaching, process implementation, and performance management.

What You’ll Do

  • Direct People Management: Lead, mentor, and manage the daily activities of both Inbound and Outbound sales representatives.
  • Execution & Accountability: Drive the team to meet and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs. You are responsible for the "how" of hitting the numbers.
  • Process Implementation: Standardize and enforce sales workflows, scripts, and outreach cadences to ensure a consistent customer experience.
  • Inbound & Outbound Oversight: Balance the team’s focus between responding to hot leads (inbound) and driving proactive growth (outbound) within the apparel and custom product space.
  • Real-Time Coaching: Conduct regular 1:1s, call monitoring, and "live" coaching sessions to improve conversion rates and objection handling.
  • CRM Discipline: Manage and optimize our CRM usage, ensuring data integrity and that no lead falls through the cracks.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Head of Sales to provide "boots on the ground" feedback and implement new initiatives quickly and efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven Leadership: 3+ years of experience as a Sales Team Lead or Sales Manager, specifically managing people in a high-volume environment.
  • Dual Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing both Inbound (lead conversion) and Outbound (prospecting/cold outreach) teams.
  • Industry Experience: Previous experience in E-commerce, Startups, or Apparel/Product Manufacturing is highly preferred.
  • Execution Mindset: You enjoy the "grind" of sales management: tracking metrics, fixing broken processes, and motivating people.
  • CRM Proficiency: Expert-level comfort with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive) and sales engagement platforms.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English skills, with the ability to provide radical candor and constructive feedback.
  • Availability: Ability to work during US Eastern and Pacific hours.

💡THE/STUDIO’s Company Values

  • Intellectually curious - possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right
  • Self-motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence
  • Good communication skills that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team
  • Radical candor - Coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable
  • Operates with a level of urgency - values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision-making, swift problem-solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment
  • Natural customer centricity - has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias towards talking to the customer to understand them
  • Results-driven - focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives

🔎 Our Typical Hiring Process

  • Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English
  • Interview with Founder/CEO
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Assessment/Case Study
  • Final Interview
  • Reference Check

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

At THE/STUDIO, we know that our Company's strength lies in the diversity of our team. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Jefe de Bodega Zona Carretera a Comalapa
location: Olocuilta, La Paz, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Objetivo Del Puesto

Planificar, coordinar y supervisar las operaciones de bodega, garantizando el control eficiente de inventarios, almacenamiento adecuado de productos y despacho oportuno, asegurando la exactitud de la información y el soporte a las operaciones comerciales y productivas de la empresa.

Funciones Principales

  • Supervisar la recepción, almacenamiento y despacho de mercadería.
  • Garantizar la exactitud de inventarios físicos vs sistema.
  • Implementar y controlar inventarios cíclicos y generales.
  • Coordinar el abastecimiento de todos los canales de ventas
  • Optimizar el uso de espacios en bodega y distribución de productos.
  • Supervisar y dirigir al personal de bodega.
  • Controlar mermas, pérdidas y diferencias de inventario.
  • Coordinar con producción, ventas y compras para asegurar disponibilidad de productos.
  • Generar reportes de inventario, rotación y movimientos.
  • Velar por el cumplimiento de normas de orden, limpieza y seguridad

Requisitos

  • Estudios técnicos o universitarios en Logística, Administración de Empresas, o carreras afines.
  • Edad: entre 30 y 50 años
  • Género: Indiferente
  • Experiencia mínima de de 3 años en control manejo de inventarios, bodegas o almacenes, preferiblemente en empresas textiles o industriales.
  • Experiencia en control de inventarios, despacho y almacenamiento.
  • Conocimiento en sistemas de inventarios (ERP).
  • Manejo de Excel intermedio o avanzado.
  • Experiencia en manejo de personal operativo.
  • Conocimiento de procesos logísticos y distribución.
  • Deseable experiencia en inventarios cíclicos y auditorías de inventario

Se Ofrece

Salario mensual $700-$750 (según experiencia)

Prestaciones de ley

Horario laboral: De lunes a jueves de 7:30 am.-5:00 pm. Y viernes de 7:30 am.-4:00 pm.

title: TECNICO ELECTROMECANICO
location: Lourdes, La Libertad, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Somos una compañía comercializadora de bebidas y alimentos con 137 años de experiencia y operaciones en Centroamérica, el Caribe y Sudamérica. Contamos con el portafolio de productos más grande de la región y trabajamos junto a nuestros socios estratégicos Pepsico, Ambev y Beliv ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras a nuestros clientes.

En CBC sabemos construir vínculos sólidos y duraderos. Sabemos escuchar a los consumidores para entender sus necesidades y ofrecerles las mejores marcas en las distintas ocasiones de consumo.

Llevamos sabor y frescura al mundo con la ambición de convertirnos en una compañía multicategoría que siga expandiendo sus horizontes. Lo hacemos con el entusiasmo de ver sonreír a nuestro equipo, a los nuestros y a quienes disfrutan lo que hacemos.

Nuestra cultura y energía transformadora tienen a la pasión como el motor que nos impulsa a ser mejores y a conquistar nuevos desafíos. Trabajamos con el disfrute de hacer juntos lo imposible.

Descripción del empleo

Mejorar continuamente la eficiencia y productividad de las líneas a través de la ejecución de las actividades de mantenimiento y uso adecuado de la maquinaria y equipo, con única finalidad de cumplir las normas de seguridad industrial, inocuidad, orden y limpieza, así como garantizar la ejecución eficiente de los servicios de mantenimiento a las diferentes áreas de la empresa.

  • Garantizar la ejecución eficiente de los servicios de mantenimiento a las diferentes áreas de la empresa.
  • Mejorar continuamente la eficiencia y productividad de las líneas a través de la ejecución de las actividades de mantenimiento y uso adecuado de la maquinaria y equipo, bajo normas de seguridad industrial, inocuidad, orden y limpieza.
  • Cumplir con todos los requerimientos del sistema de Gestión de Inocuidad (BPM, PPR, HACCP/ HARPC, Food Defense) y delatar toda condición que comprometa la inocuidad de los productos elaborados en planta. Garantizando el cumplimiento de objetivos del manual de Gestión de Inocuidad.

Requisitos

Graduado de Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Eléctrica o carrera afín.

Experiencia de 1 a 3 años en mejora continua y gestión de proyectos.

Conocimiento en metodologías de mejora de procesos (Lean, Six Sigma u otras).

Persona organizada, con capacidad de análisis, liderazgo de equipos multidisciplinarios y orientación a resultados.

Información adicional

La misión de Grupo Mariposa es fomentar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad dentro de la industria global de alimentos y bebidas. Estamos comprometidos con la excelencia a través de una gestión disciplinada, prácticas innovadoras y una cultura dinámica que acepta el cambio.

title: Senior Marketing Research Executive - Full inglés
location: Colonia Escalón, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Role Objective

Lead and manage market research projects with a strong commercial orientation, transforming data into actionable insights that drive business decisions, product development, and competitive positioning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, coordinate, and execute quantitative and qualitative market research studies.
  • Analyze consumer trends, customer behavior, and commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare executive reports and bilingual presentations (English–Spanish) for management and clients.
  • Identify business opportunities based on research findings.
  • Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients, ensuring quality and relevance of deliverables.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, field teams, and digital research platforms.
  • Support the development of commercial proposals and marketing strategies based on data-driven insights.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Communications, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in market research with a commercial focus.
  • Fluent bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (oral and written), with ability to present and negotiate in both languages.
  • Advanced skills in data analysis tools (Excel, SPSS, Power BI, or similar).
  • Knowledge of research methodologies (surveys, interviews, focus groups, trend analysis).
  • Strong executive communication and persuasive skills.
  • Project management capabilities and results-oriented mindset.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical and strategic thinking.
  • Commercial proactivity and initiative.
  • Negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Adaptability and ability to work in multicultural environments.
  • Professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.

location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 33,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities

Apoyar el ingreso de información de la participación y monitoreo de la niñez registrada de la zona en el sistema Horizon.

Garantizar el proceso de entrega de GNs de la niñez registrada en la zona de acuerdo a los estándares de patrocinio en tiempo y calidad hasta cerrar el proceso.

Gestión de la flota asignada a la zona asegurando el cumplimiento de los lineamientos y políticas organizacionales. Coordinaciones de seguimiento y administración de mantenimientos con Supervisor de Flota y Coordinador de Zona.

Gestiones de registro de procesos en Sistema con Asistente de Zona, en coordinación con los FDs para el control y buenas prácticas del uso de la flota.

Garantizar el control de inventario de Activos Fijos de la zona, en estrecha coordinación con Administrador/a de Activos Fijos en ON, garantizando el cumplimiento de políticas y protocolos de manejo de activos.

Gestionar y garantizar el adecuado registro y resguardo de la entrega de bienes y recursos a beneficiarios de acuerdo a los lineamientos organizacionales que permiten la adecuada rendición de cuentas.

Colaborar con asistente administrativo de la zona en proceso estratégicos como: Ingreso de Plan de compras, planificación presupuestaria anual, entre otras, previa coordinación y autorización de coordinador/a de zona.

Applicant Types Accepted

Local Applicants Only

title: Bookkeeper
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Numbers make sense to you — and messy books don’t stand a chance.

We’re looking for a full-time Bookkeeper who lives and breathes QuickBooks Online, keeps financial records spotless, and communicates clearly in English.

About the Company:

This is a full-time role for one of our internal companies, a leading provider of Quality of Earnings and due diligence services for online business acquisitions. They work with business buyers—searchers, aggregators, family offices, and first-time acquirers—to help them make confident, informed decisions.

  • Manage daily bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online, Quickbooks Desktop and XERO (experience desired, not mandatory)
  • Handle reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close
  • Maintain accurate financial records and reports
  • Track expenses, income, AR/AP, and general ledger
  • Prepare financial data for reviews and decision-making
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders in English

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

  • Certified Accountant (non-negotiable)
  • QuickBooks Online and Desktop and Xero experience is a plus
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work full-time and independently
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and process-oriented

Your Perks: What's in it for you

  • 💰 Competitive monthly rate based on experience & qualifications
  • 📅 Full-time, long-term role
  • 🌍 Work with an international environment
  • 📈 Stable workload with clear expectations
  • 🤝 Professional, respectful collaboration

We understand your time is valuable, so we strive to keep the assessment process under 45 minutes whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.

Once selected, you’ll have the chance to schedule your first interview with our team. We aim to make the process as smooth and transparent as possible, so you’ll always know where you stand.

location: El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
About Us
Kreato Language Group LLC, founded in 2020, is a BPO company specializing in providing comprehensive language solutions. We offer expertise in medical interpretation through Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) services, ensuring smooth communication in the healthcare sector.

Job Description
This is a full-time remote position as an English- Spanish Experienced Medical Interpreter in a Blended (OPI & VRI) environment. The medical interpreter will be responsible for providing accurate consecutive interpretation services over the phone and via video between English and Spanish  in medical, social services, customer service, and financial settings. The role involves facilitating communication between healthcare providers and patients to ensure effective understanding and care.

Qualifications

  • Medical, customer service, social services, and financial calls interpretation skills
  • Knowledge of medical terminology
  • Fluency in English and Spanish
  • Remote interpretation experience in both languages is mandatory
  • Excellent communication and listening skills
  • Relevant certification in medical interpretation or a related field
  • HIPAA compliance

Requirements

  • Ethernet connection (must be connected directly to the router via cable); Wi-Fi is not allowed
  • Noise-canceling microphone and USB headset. Only the following brands are accepted: Logitech H390, Jabra GN, Plantronics Blackwire C3220(Poly), and Microsoft Lifechat LX-6000
  • Browser: Latest version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox
  • Processor: i5 or higher, 6th generation or newer
  • Camera: Minimum resolution of 1080p
  • Full-time availability, 5 days a week (2 days off)

What We Offer

  • Pay per available hour (whether you are on a call or not, the hour is paid)
  • Work from home (remote)
  • Excellent work environment
  • Opportunities for growth

Start date

  • February 2026

companySlogan: Breaking language barriers with expert OPI, VRI, Translation & Localization services.
companyDescription:
About Kreato Global

Founded in 2020, Kreato Global is a premier Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner dedicated to delivering comprehensive, world-class language solutions. We are passionate about breaking down language barriers and bridging communication gaps for organizations worldwide. By combining top-tier linguistic talent with reliable technology, we ensure seamless, accurate, and culturally appropriate interactions for every client we serve.

Our Core Language Services

We offer a complete ecosystem of language and accessibility solutions tailored to your operational needs:

Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI): On-demand, high-quality audio interpretation for immediate communication needs.

Video Remote Interpretation (VRI): Face-to-face virtual interpretation that provides vital visual context, especially crucial in healthcare.

Remote Simultaneous Interpretation (RSI): Real-time, seamless interpretation designed for multilingual webinars and large-scale virtual events.

Onsite Interpretation: Professional, in-person interpreters deployed directly to your facility for critical meetings.

American Sign Language (ASL): Certified ASL interpreters providing essential accessibility and inclusive communication.

title: Web Designer (Worldwide - Remote)
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Wing Assistant provides dedicated remote talent to entrepreneurs, executives, and fast-growing teams - helping them move faster, stay focused, and operate at a higher level.

Our mission is simple: free people from work that slows them down, so they can do the work that matters. Our website and digital design presence are core growth engines. The way we visually communicate trust, clarity, and value directly impacts conversions, perception, and adoption.

We are expanding our web team with a Web Designer who brings clean design, excellent execution, and a strong sense of ownership.

About The Role

As a Web Designer at Wing Assistant, you will design and build website pages, landing pages, and marketing collateral used across our growth funnels. This role blends visual design + web implementation, with additional support for brand storytelling, sales enablement, and campaign execution. You'll collaborate with the Marketing and Sales teams - turning messaging and value propositions into high-performing, visually consistent assets used across web, paid campaigns, sales decks, outbound, and email nurturing.

This is a role for someone who understands that good design is not just about visuals - but clarity, hierarchy, persuasion, and intent.

Note: This is an Individual Contributor role where a high frequency and speed of production of design and creation is expected.

Responsibilities

  • Web & Landing Page Design
  • Design and build new pages and landing pages in WordPress, Webflow, and Framer
  • Improve and refine existing pages for clarity, visual structure, and conversion
  • Work with the Senior Web Designer to evolve and maintain the design system
  • Translate messaging frameworks into clear, conversion-optimized layouts
  • Ensure responsive, mobile-first, readability-focused execution
  • Sales Enablement & Brand Design
  • Design sales collateral such as pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, and brochures
  • Support the sales team with presentation assets, visual frameworks, and messaging structure
  • Create visual assets for outbound campaigns, email nurtures, and LinkedIn campaigns
  • Develop brand-consistent graphics, banners, icons, and visual patterns
  • Performance & Iteration
  • Apply insights from analytics (scroll depth, session replays, heatmaps, CRO tests)
  • Implement testing-oriented design changes to support conversion rate uplift
  • Ensure all output is polished, stable, performance-optimized, and visually consistent


Requirements

  • 2-5 years of experience in web design + web implementation
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating clean UI, spacing, visual hierarchy, and typography discipline
  • Real shipped pages and website work (not only Dribble/Behance concepts)
  • Conversion-minded layouts or marketing-focused execution
  • Proficiency in Figma (components, auto-layout, structured systems), Webflow, WordPress (modern builders / block editors), Framer (or ability to learn quickly)
  • Comfort adjusting HTML/CSS when needed
  • Understanding of UX fundamentals: spacing, rhythm, contrast, CTA placement, narrative flow
  • Ability to collaborate, accept feedback, and iterate quickly


Nice to have

  • Experience working in B2B SaaS, agency, or service-based growth environments
  • CRO / analytics experience (Hotjar, GA4, A/B testing platforms)
  • Animation or micro-interactions (Webflow Interactions / Framer Motion)
  • Basic SEO awareness (semantic structure, performance scoring, accessibility)
  • Experience supporting sales teams, SDRs, or customer success enablement


Compensation

$1500-$2000 USD Per Month

We are committed to fair and competitive compensation. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, etc. The pay for a successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Fashion Designer (Sales/Account Management)
location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
descriptionHtml:
Use your design background to drive global business.

At THE/STUDIO, we’ve found that the most successful business leads aren't just great communicators—they’re people who actually understand how products are made.

We are looking for Fashion Designers who are ready to transition into high-impact, customer-facing roles. Whether your strength lies in building long-term relationships (Account Management), chasing new leads (Outbound Sales), or converting high-intent interest (Inbound Sales), we have a seat for you.

Why you? You understand tech packs, materials, and the creative process. That knowledge makes you a massive asset to our clients. Instead of just "selling," you’ll be consulting and solving problems for brands globally.

The Essentials

  • Background: Fashion or Product Design (Degree or 2+ years experience).
  • Ambition: A clear desire to move into a commercial, results-driven role.
  • Environment: Comfortable in a fast-paced, fully remote team (Must be comfortable working during US hours).
  • Mindset: You care about the "how" and "why" behind the business.

Roles we are hiring for:

  • Customer Success (Account Management)
  • Account Executive (Outbound)
  • Inside Sales (Inbound)

More information below.

Location: Fully Remote (US Business Hours)

Role Type: Sales / Account Management / Operations

About The Role

At THE/STUDIO, we are disrupting the manufacturing industry by bridging the gap between design and supply chain. We’ve discovered that individuals with a background in Fashion Design possess a "technical empathy" that makes them incredible business partners for our clients.

We Are Looking For Design-trained Professionals To Join Our Commercial Team. Based On Your Personality And Strengths, We Will "stream" You Into One Of Three Core Functions

  • Customer Success Manager (Account Management): You are the long-term partner for our existing clients. You’ll manage the post-sales lifecycle, ensuring project success, driving retention, and identifying opportunities for account growth and upselling.
  • Account Executive: You are a high-level "Closer." You will manage a pipeline of qualified e-commerce leads, using your industry expertise to pitch THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and convert large-scale opportunities into active partnerships.
  • Inside Sales Representative (Sr. Creative Specialist): You are the bridge between a lead and a product. You will handle inbound inquiries, acting as a technical consultant to help customers refine their creative concepts and navigate the production process to finalize their first orders.

What You’ll Do

  • Consultative Strategy: Use your knowledge of garment construction and materials to provide expert advice, ensuring client designs are production-ready.
  • Creative Problem Solving: Navigate manufacturing complexities by translating vague creative visions into actionable, high-quality production orders.
  • Pipeline & Portfolio Management: Manage a high volume of interactions, whether it’s closing new business or nurturing a book of existing accounts, within our CRM.
  • Revenue Impact: Directly influence company growth by hitting KPIs related to conversion rates, order value, and client lifetime value.

Who You Are

  • The "Business-Minded Creative": You love fashion, but you find the business of fashion (margins, logistics, and scalability) just as exciting as the aesthetic.
  • Technical Translator: You can look at a tech pack or a sketch and immediately explain the operational requirements to a client.
  • Resilient & High-Agency: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where you are expected to take ownership of your desk and hit targets.
  • Expert Communicator: You possess the "Sales DNA" required to persuade and lead a customer, backed by the credibility of a design background.

Requirements

  • Education: Degree in Fashion Design, Product Design, or a related creative field.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to understand design files, tech packs, and manufacturing specs.
  • Communication: Native or professional-level English fluency with a confident "consultative" tone.
  • Alignment: Availability to work consistently during US Business Hours (EST/PST).
  • Experience: Previous experience in sales, retail, or a customer-facing role is highly preferred.

💡THE/STUDIO’s Company Values

  • Intellectually curious - possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right
  • Self-motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence
  • Good communication skills that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team
  • Radical candor - Coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable
  • Operates with a level of urgency - values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision-making, swift problem-solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment
  • Natural customer centricity - has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias towards talking to the customer to understand them
  • Results-driven - focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives

🔎 Our Typical Hiring Process

  • Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English
  • Complete the video question
  • Initial Interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Assessment/Case Study
  • Final Interview
  • Reference Check

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

At THE/STUDIO, we know that our Company's strength lies in the diversity of our team. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.
